assertions.text: Cell values make the rule falsifiable, not merely distinguishable
assertions.evidence: Each table's expectation values vary meaningfully with inputs (e.g. 7.50 vs 17.50, 7.50 vs 8.625, 10.50 vs 13.50), and no expectation cell is a verbatim copy of an input cell; the carrier table's value-set (12.00 for {DHL, UPS, FEDEX}) tests invariance, a documented TableTest pattern, not a constant-ignoring implementation.
